name: Monster Lover: Balasque
source:
“Summon a Vengeance Demon,” they said. “What could go wrong?” they said.

Our main character is in over his head! Fortunately, the demon Balasque has taken a liking to him. Wait…is that actually fortunate?


When our main character is tricked by scammers into turning his father’s museum into an upscale rage room, he has no where to turn! 

These creeps are destroying his father’s legacy, and they’ve done even worse in the past. In his desperation, he finds an old museum artifact attached to an ancient demon and gives it a try.

There’s no way this can work, right? …Right?

Well, Balasque is here, and he’s ready to take some vengeance!

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ypressgames/monster-lover]Kickstarter[/url]]
translation:
“召唤复仇恶魔吧，”他们说。“能出什么问题？”他们说。

我们的主人公已经无法应付眼前的局面！幸好，恶魔巴拉斯克看上了他。等等…这真的是好事吗？

主人公遭骗子欺骗，将父亲的博物馆改成了高档发泄室，如今已走投无路！

这些混蛋正在毁掉父亲的心血，而他们以前还做过更恶劣的事。绝望中，他找到一件与古老恶魔有关的博物馆藏品，决定试试看。

这怎么可能有用，对吧？…对吧？

好吧，巴拉斯克来了，而且已经准备好展开复仇！

[摘自[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ypressgames/monster-lover]Kickstarter[/url]]
